note: Gate replay vectors for flare-notify-rules. See README section 'Vectors' for the replay rules.

scenarios.name: first_message_rings
scenarios.note: The first message of an idle slot rings.

scenarios.name: direct_sparse_rings_every_message
scenarios.note: Messages further apart than the direct loud interval all ring.

scenarios.name: group_burst_coalesced_with_quiet_tail
scenarios.note: Messages inside the 2 s update interval are absorbed; one tail refresh carries the count. The tail steps the update ladder up to 5 s.

scenarios.name: loud_ladder_steps_up_and_down
scenarios.note: Group loud ladder 30/120/600 s: a suppressed message steps it up at the next ring; 720 s of quiet (one 600 s and one 120 s interval) steps it back to 30 s.

scenarios.name: loud_ladder_partial_step_down
scenarios.note: One full 600 s quiet interval steps down one level only.

scenarios.name: device_bucket_across_conversations
scenarios.note: Bucket of 3 refilled every 15 s: the fourth new conversation appears quietly.

scenarios.name: device_min_gap_applies_to_every_ring
scenarios.note: No two rings within 1 s, priority included.

scenarios.name: priority_bypasses_slot_ladder_and_bucket
scenarios.note: Mentions ring with an empty bucket and inside the slot ladder; they also restart the slot's loud timer.

scenarios.name: priority_storm_limited_by_min_gap
scenarios.note: A mention every 400 ms rings at most once per second.

scenarios.name: quiet_tier_never_rings
scenarios.note: Quiet-hours deliveries are coalesced like everything else and never ring.

scenarios.name: quiet_tier_flood
scenarios.note: A quiet-hours flood: zero rings, the update ladder climbs, the final tail shows the full count.

scenarios.name: vendor_cap_defers_first_message
scenarios.note: Over the vendor cap even an idle slot's first message waits for the window to end.

scenarios.name: vendor_cap_redefers_tail
scenarios.note: A tail that meets a full vendor window is rescheduled to the window end.

scenarios.name: digest_enter_and_ring
scenarios.note: Six conversations within 60 s enter digest mode; the digest rings 60 s after entry, then on its own ladder (120 s).

scenarios.name: digest_exit_after_quiet_window
scenarios.note: Fewer than two pushes in 120 s leaves digest mode.

scenarios.name: priority_rings_in_digest_mode
scenarios.note: Digest mode does not hold back mentions.

scenarios.name: read_clears_visible_slot
scenarios.note: Read closes the slot; a clear is needed only for a live slot that was sent.

scenarios.name: read_of_never_sent_slot
scenarios.note: A slot whose only message is still waiting for the vendor window needs no clear.

scenarios.name: active_resets_slots_and_digest
scenarios.note: Returning to Active invalidates every slot and leaves digest mode.

scenarios.name: idle_slot_expiry
scenarios.note: 30 minutes without messages expires the slot; the next message is a first message again.

scenarios.name: one_group_ten_thousand_messages_in_an_hour
scenarios.note: Design example: 10 000 messages in one group over an hour. Rings at 0, 30, 150, 750 s and then every 600 s (8 in total); the notification is updated by 15 quiet tails; 23 vendor calls; the last update shows all 10 000 messages.

scenarios.name: twenty_conversations_at_once
scenarios.note: Design example: twenty conversations start within one second and stay busy for ten minutes. Digest mode is entered at the sixth conversation; afterwards at most one ring per minute (the digest ladder 60/120/300 s); after the storm digest mode ends and a new message rings again.
